purpose: Small mechanism test of explicit-person filtering before BM25, not a 257-case performance claim

cases_fixed_before_ranking.reason: official-reference miss but sufficient alternative evidence in top5
answer already sufficient despite redundant official references
two-person claim with one-sided top5 evidence

speaker_rule: Exact casefold match of a query-supplied person's name to a structured dialogue turn speaker; multiple people use OR, not AND
mention_rule: Whole-word case-insensitive name occurrence in original source text, diagnostic only
query_rule: Unchanged raw question and archived lexical_expression, unicode61 FTS5 BM25; no answer text or reference IDs enter ranking
outcomes: reference retention, Top5/Top10 official reference coverage, Top5 original-history provenance, manually checked answer sufficiency examples
limitations: Names can collide across unrelated people; third-party mentions need not be speakers; questions with no explicit person (e.g. first-person LongMemEval) are outside this pilot. Selected cases are known diagnostic examples, not blind samples.
